description: Tests the ability of users to add a product to the shopping cart and review the cart contents.
steps: Click on the 'SHOP NOW' button under the Women's category.
Wait for the Women's category page to load.
Locate and click on the product link 'Blue Denim Shorts'.
Wait for the product details page of 'Blue Denim Shorts' to load.
Click on the 'Add to Cart' button on the product page.
Wait for the cart page to load.
Verify that 'Blue Denim Shorts' is displayed in the shopping cart with correct pricing.
expected_results: Product 'Blue Denim Shorts' is successfully added to the cart.
Cart page displays 'Blue Denim Shorts' with correct pricing.
User can proceed to checkout from the cart page.
edge_cases: Add to Cart button is non-functional.
Product does not appear in the cart after adding.
Cart page fails to load or displays incorrect information.
Network latency causes delayed cart updates.
Cart page does not display checkout options.
data_requirements: Product 'Blue Denim Shorts' must exist and be purchasable.
Shopping cart functionality must be enabled.
Cart page must have valid data (product name, price).
User must have permissions to add products to the cart.
Database must maintain cart state for the session.
dependencies: Product 'Blue Denim Shorts' must be listed under Women's category.
Add to Cart functionality must be implemented.
api_interactions: POST /cart/add to add the product to the cart.
performance_metrics: Response time for adding a product to the cart.
Page load time for the cart page.
Time taken to update cart contents.
accessibility_requirements: Ensure that all buttons have accessible labels.
Verify that cart page is keyboard-navigable.
Check for proper color contrast on the cart page.
